helpPlay: p <idx>              Play the card at idx
rule: Winning a trick scores nothing. All it earns is the right to draw one card from the stock -- so while you keep winning, your hand never shrinks. Run out of cards and you are out; the last player still holding cards wins. You are dealt as many cards as there are players (four each at a four-player table), and the rest is the stock.
noStockLine: The stock is empty. Nobody can refill now -- eliminations come quickly from here.
promptEliminated: You are out. The remaining players will finish it between them.
gameEndYou: Game over! You held cards longest.
hintReasonWinTrick: Take it and you draw a replacement
hintReasonNoStock: You can take it, but the stock is empty -- no refill
hintReasonDuck: You cannot take it, so play low
